campus_notes: Compiled 2026-09-14 from Dartmouth's Office of Residential Life, which lists every building by house community and publishes a downloadable floor plan for each, along with its room types: one-room singles and doubles, two- and three-room doubles with a shared common space, two- and three-room triples, a few quads, suite-style living and three- and four-bedroom apartments. No room dimensions appear in text, so every room here uses the site's estimate fallback and is labelled "Estimated based on similar rooms. Official size not published." Dartmouth houses over 3,300 students and roughly 88-90% of undergraduates live on campus.
